quests.instruction: Touch the classroom object we use to carry our storybooks and lunchboxes safely!
quests.question: Backpack
quests.explanation: Take your time and look closely. You'll get it right next time!
quests.funFact: A backpack is like a turtle's shell, carrying everything you need for the day!

quests.instruction: Touch the classroom object we use to write words and draw beautiful houses!
quests.question: Pencil
quests.explanation: Take your time and look closely. You'll get it right next time!
quests.funFact: Pencils have special graphite inside that leaves a mark when it rubs paper!

quests.funFact: Erasers are magical rubber blocks that can make your pencil mistakes disappear!
